qa.question: If the Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards is itself yellow, does this card’s inherited effect activate?
qa.answer: Yes, if a Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards is itself yellow, the effect activates.

qa.question: How does this card’s inherited effect work, exactly?
qa.answer: At the end of your turn, this effect allows you DNA digivolve a Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards, along with one of your other Digimon, into a Digimon in your hand that has [DNA Digivolve]. Note that this happens before it becomes your opponent’s turn.

qa.question: With this card's inherited effect, can I DNA digivolve into a Digimon card in my hand that doesn’t have [DNA Digivolve]?
qa.answer: No. You can’t ignore the digivolution requirements, so you can’t DNA digivolve into a Digimon card that doesn’t have [DNA Digivolve].

qa.question: Does this card's inherited effect allow me to DNA digivolve into a card other than the Digimon specified by [DNA Digivolution] in the hand?
qa.answer: No. You can’t ignore the digivolution requirements, so you can’t DNA digivolve using Digimon that aren’t specified in [DNA Digivolution].

qa.question: Does this card’s [On Play] effect force me to reveal 3 cards from the top of my deck?
qa.answer: Yes. The effect reads, “Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck,” so if you don’t have 3 cards left in your deck, reveal as many as you can.

qa.question: This card's [On Play] effect reveals cards from the top of my deck. If I reveal both yellow and purple cards, do I have to add both of them to my hand?
qa.answer: Yes. The effect reads, “Add 1 card...to your hand,” so if you reveal a card that meets the requirements, you must add it to your hand.

qa.question: With this card's inherited effect, can I DNA digivolve into to DNA digivolve into a Digimon card in my hand that doesn’t have [DNA Digivolve]?

qa.question: I activated this card's [Your Turn] effect when I played [ST10-04 Gatomon]. At such times, I want to digivolve [ST10-04 Gatomon] into [Angewomon] or [LadyDevimon] with the cost reduced by 1, but can I use [ST10-04 Gatomon]'s [Your Turn] effect to reduce the digivolution cost again by 2?
qa.answer: Yes, that's correct.

qa.question: If the Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards is itself purple, does this card’s inherited effect activate?
qa.answer: Yes, if a Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards is itself purple, the effect activates.

qa.question: If this card's effect is activated on the opponent's turn, how long does the effect last?
qa.answer: When the effect of this card is activated on the opponent's turn, it lasts until the end of that turn.

changes.before: [When Digivolving] Place 1 yellow or purple Digimon card from your trash on top of your security stack face down. When DNA digivolving, you may search your security stack for 1 level 5 or lower Digimon card and play it without paying its memory cost. Then, shuffle your security stack.
changes.after:
[When Digivolving] Place 1 yellow or purple Digimon card from your trash on top of your security stack face down. When DNA digivolving, search your security stack, and you may play 1 level 5 or lower Digimon card among it without paying its cost.
Then, shuffle your security stack.

qa.question: Does this card’s [When Digivolving] effect activate when performing a non-DNA digivolve?
qa.answer:
When performing a non-DNA digivolution, only the “Place 1 yellow or purple Digimon card from your trash on top of your security stack face down” part of the effect activates. The part of the effect that reads, “you may search your security stack for 1 level 5 or lower Digimon card and play it without paying its memory cost” only activates when DNA digivolving.
“Then, shuffle your security stack” activates no matter what kind of digivolution you perform.

qa.question: Does this card's [All Turns] effect also activate when the [Security] effect of one of my Security Digimon plays it into my battle area?
qa.answer: Yes, it does.

qa.question: Does this card's [All Turns] effect activate when [BT1-089 Mimi Tachikawa]'s effect moves a Digimon from my breeding area to my battle area?
qa.answer: No, moving a Digimon from your breeding area doesn’t count as playing it, so the effect doesn’t activate.

qa.question: My level 4 Digimon was played by an effect, then this card's [All Turns] effect and another effect triggered simultaneously. I activated the other effect, then the level of my Digimon that was played by an effect increased from 4 to 5. If I then activate this card's [All Turns] effect, what levels of Digimon can I delete?
qa.answer:
Level 4 or lower.
If the same reference to a "played" trigger condition being performed is made for an effect when it has a "when X is played" trigger condition, the state when the effect has triggered will be referenced.
In this case, your Digimon was level 4 when this card's [All Turns] effect triggered, therefore you can delete a level 4 or lower Digimon.

qa.question: My level 4 Digimon was played by an effect, then this card's [All Turns] effect and another effect triggered simultaneously. I activated the other effect, then my Digimon that was played by an effect was removed from the battle area. If I then activate this card's [All Turns] effect, can I delete an opponent's Digimon?
qa.answer:
Yes, you can delete it.
If the same reference to a "played" trigger condition being performed is made for an effect when it has a "when X is played" trigger condition, the state when the effect has triggered will be referenced.
In this case, your Digimon was level 4 when this card's [All Turns] effect triggered, therefore you can delete a level 4 or lower Digimon.

qa.question: When my opponent had 2 cards in their security attack, they activated [ST10-06 Mastemon]'s [When Digivolving] effect, and the effect that places a card from their trash in their security stack and the effect that plays a level 5 or lower Digimon card activated. My opponent temporarily has 3 cards in their security stack, then it becomes 2 cards. Can I activate this card's [All Turns] effect?
qa.answer:
No, you can't activate it.
Even if an effect activates and increases your opponent's security stack, their security stack must have 3 or more cards when the effect finishes activating.

qa.question: Does this card’s [On Play] effect force me to reveal 3 cards from the top of my deck?
qa.answer: Yes. The effect reads, "Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck," so if possible, you must reveal 3 cards. If you have fewer than 3 cards left in your deck, reveal as many as you can.

qa.question: This card's [On Play] effect reveals cards from the top of my deck. If I reveal a card with [Angel], [Archangel], or [Fallen Angel] in its traits, do I have to add it to my hand?
qa.answer: Yes. The effect reads, “Add 1 card...to your hand,” so if you reveal a card that meets the requirements, you must add it to your hand.

qa.question: Can I play this Digimon with its [Security] effect even if it loses the battle against the attacking Digimon?
qa.answer: Yes, regardless of the battle's outcome, you get to play this Digimon at the end of the battle.

qa.question: Does this card’s [On Play] effect activate when played with this card’s [Security] effect?
qa.answer: Yes, it does.

qa.question: This card is flipped over during a security check, but the attacking Digimon still has security checks remaining. Does this Digimon’s effect activate first, or do I have to wait until my opponent finishes the rest of their security checks?
qa.answer:
This Digimon is played after the battle with the attacking Digimon, and before the next check is performed.
Likewise, this Digimon’s [On Play] effect activates before your opponent’s next check.

qa.question: Does this card’s [When Digivolving] effect force me to reveal 3 cards from the top of my deck when digivolving?
qa.answer: No. The effect reads, "You may trash 1 card in your hand to...," so if you choose not to trash a card in your hand, the rest of the effect won't activate.

qa.question: This card's [When Digivolving] effect reveals cards from the top of my deck. If I reveal yellow and purple cards that both have [Angel], [Archangel], or [Fallen Angel] in their traits, do I have to add them to my hand?
qa.answer: Yes. The effect reads, “Add 1 yellow and 1 purple card...to your hand,” so if you reveal cards that meet the requirements, you must add them to your hand.

qa.question: If I use this card’s effect to place an opponent’s Digimon at the top of their security stack, is that Digimon then trashed?
qa.answer:
Yes, that's correct.
If you choose to place an opponent’s Digimon at the top of their security stack, you are in effect choosing to trash the chosen Digimon.

qa.question: What happens if I use this card while my opponent has [BT9-103 Kongou]'s effect activated?
qa.answer: Due to [BT9-103 Kongou]'s effect, cards can't be placed in security stacks, therefore this card's "place 1 of your opponent's Digimon face down at the top or bottom of your opponent's security stack" can't be activated, and the target Digimon will be left as-is.

qa.question: If I use this card’s effect to place an opponent’s Digimon at the top of their security stack, does that Digimon’s [On Deletion] effect activate? Additionally, do effects on other Digimon and Tamers that care about Digimon being deleted also activate?
qa.answer: No. The Digimon isn’t being deleted, so none of the above occurs.

qa.question: What happens if my opponent activates this card's effect and I use [ST10-14 Chaos Degradation]?
qa.answer: Due to this card's effect, cards can't be placed in security stacks, therefore [ST10-14 Chaos Degradation]'s "place 1 of your opponent's Digimon face down at the top or bottom of your opponent's security stack" can't be activated, and the target Digimon will be left as-is.

qa.question: I use this card’s effect to trash the top 3 cards of my deck. If a yellow or purple Digimon card is among those cards, can I then use this effect to return it from my trash to my hand?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

comprehensive-0223.title: <Blocker>
comprehensive-0223.text:
16-5. <Blocker>
16-5-1. <Blocker> is a keyword effect that applies a rule that allows a Digimon with that effect to block. (For details, refer to 12 "Blocking")
16-5-2. <Blocker> is a persistent effect. (For details, refer to 15-8-2 "Persistent Effects")
16-5-3. Even if 1 Digimon has multiple instances of <Blocker>, the number of blocks that can be performed during the block timing is only 1.

comprehensive-0226.title: <Draw>
comprehensive-0226.text:
16-8. <Draw>
16-8-1. <Draw> is a keyword effect where a player draws the cards from their deck according to the number specified in the effect. This is shown on cards using text such as <Draw 1>.
16-8-2. <Draw> effects execute processing.
16-8-3. A draw from <Draw> is mandatory.

comprehensive-0231.title: <Retaliation>
comprehensive-0231.text:
16-13. <Retaliation>
16-13-1. <Retaliation> is a keyword effect where a battled opponent's Digimon is deleted when a Digimon with this effect is deleted in battle.
16-13-2. <Retaliation> is a trigger-type effect that triggers when just the Digimon with this effect is deleted in battle. (For details, refer to 15-8-3 "Trigger-Type Effects")
16-13-3. The processing from <Retaliation> is mandatory.
